name: Text to SQL (execution-graded)
description: Turn questions into SQLite queries. Graded by running the model's query and the gold query on the same in-memory database and comparing results.
system: You write SQLite queries. Reply with only the SQL query, no explanation.
prompt_prefix:
Schema (SQLite):
customers(id, name, country, signup_date)
products(id, name, category, price)
orders(id, customer_id, order_date, status)   -- status: shipped | pending | cancelled
order_items(order_id, product_id, quantity)

Question:

items.prompt: How many customers are from the US?

check.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE country='US'

items.prompt: List the names of products in the 'gear' category.

check.gold: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category='gear'

items.prompt: What is the most expensive product's name?

check.gold: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status='pending'

items.prompt: List the names of customers who signed up in 2025.

check.gold: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date LIKE '2025%'

items.prompt: What is the average product price?
How many orders did Ava Chen place?

check.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE c.name='Ava Chen'

items.prompt: Show each country and its number of customers.

check.gold: SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY country

items.prompt: What is the total quantity of 'Wool Socks' ever ordered (all orders)?

check.gold: SELECT SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id WHERE p.name='Wool Socks'

items.prompt: List the names of customers who have at least one shipped order.

check.gold: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id WHERE o.status='shipped'

items.prompt: What is the total revenue (price times quantity) of shipped orders?

check.gold: SELECT SUM(p.price*oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id=oi.order_id WHERE o.status='shipped'

items.prompt: Which customers have never placed an order? Return their names.

check.gold: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT customer_id FROM orders)

items.prompt: For each product category, what is the total quantity sold across all orders?

check.gold: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id=oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category

items.prompt: Which customer name has placed the most orders?

check.gold: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.prompt: How many orders were placed in March 2026?

check.gold: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date LIKE '2026-03%'
